attributes.board_name: Alaska Division of Corporations, Business and Professional Licensing – Audiologist and Speech-Language Pathologist Program

rules.alternatives: No state CE hours. At renewal the SLP certifies holding the ASHA Certificate of Clinical Competence in speech-language pathology (or its equivalent) during the whole licensing period (AS 08.11.015(5)); keeping the CCC means meeting ASHA's own certification maintenance.
rules.audit_note: The division audits a percentage of renewals; keep documentation at least 4 years (12 AAC 02.960).
rules.notes: Licenses expire September 30 of even-numbered years; no grace period. Neither AS 08.11 nor 12 AAC 07 sets CE hours for licensed SLPs.

rules.alternatives: No state CE hours in AS 08.11 or 12 AAC 07 for audiologists.
rules.notes: Biennial licenses expire September 30 of even-numbered years. The audiologist renewal form was not available online to confirm whether a CCC-A attestation is asked at renewal.

rules.accepted_credit_types: State or regional conferences, workshops, formal in-service training, independent study programs, or a combination, pertaining to communication disorders.
rules.audit_note: Sworn statement on the renewal; random audits, keep documents at least 4 years.
rules.notes: The supervising SLP helps the assistant build a professional development plan that includes the 15 clock hours biennially.
rules.rule_quote: …accompanied by a sworn statement that the applicant has available documentation of approved continuing education consisting of 15 clock hours for the preceding two years.
